scope.flow: FlashAccountant lock settlement during a swap with a non-standard token
scope.environment: Ekubo Router / FlashAccountant with a malicious or fee-on-transfer token

entities.name: Per-token debt record for active lock

statements.text: A lock is active and debts recorded during the lock must be settled to zero before the lock concludes.
The input token has non-standard behavior such as fee-on-transfer, so the pool receives less than the requested amount.
The Router attempts to collect swap payment using payFrom with a snapshot-and-diff mechanism.
The malicious token's transferFrom re-enters updateDebt during the same lock.
The token calls updateDebt(-tax) to erase the unpaid remainder of its own debt entry for the active lock.
The lock concludes successfully despite the tax amount remaining unpaid.
updateDebt allows any address to modify its own debt record for the current lock without authorization, and debts are keyed by token address with updateDebt applying to msg.sender.
The pool pays out the output asset as if fully paid while receiving less than the required input assets, suffering a loss equal to the tax.
The invariant that pools can never become insolvent in the other token due to non-standard behavior in one token is violated.
All debts recorded during a lock must be settled to zero before the lock concludes, so a lock must not pass while any recorded debt remains unpaid.
An address must not be able to modify its own debt record for the current lock without authorization.
Pools must never become insolvent in the other token due to non-standard behavior in one token.

ambiguities: Report does not specify the exact swap amounts, tax value, or which token is input versus output beyond the tax loss.
Whether the malicious token is the same token whose debt is erased is stated via msg.sender keying but the concrete call path is not fully detailed.
No explicit prior transaction establishing the debt record before the swap is described; debt is recorded during the lock.
